import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { existsSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';

const sourceRevision = execFileSync('git', ['rev-parse', 'HEAD'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();
const scenario = JSON.parse(readFileSync(
  'ooui/apps/cross-office-client-e2e/scenarios/bizchat-create-canary-excel.yaml', 'utf8'));
const scratchRoot = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'synthetic-1js-repair-'));
const unownedResource = join(scratchRoot, 'unowned-session.json');
writeFileSync(unownedResource, 'preserve-this-session');
const report = {
  provenance: 'synthetic',
  sourceRevision,
  validationWorkspace: process.cwd(),
  scratchRoot,
  retries: 0,
  expectedValue: 15,
  requiredConsecutivePasses: 5,
  consecutivePasses: 0,
  runs: [],
  failure: null,
  ownedResourcesRemoved: false,
  unownedResourcePreserved: false
};
try {
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(scenario).sort(),
    ['increment', 'name', 'restoreSetting', 'seedValue']);
  assert.equal(scenario.name, 'Synthetic seeded-workbook qualification');
  assert.equal(typeof scenario.seedValue, 'number');
  assert.equal(scenario.increment, 10);
  assert.equal(typeof scenario.restoreSetting, 'boolean');
  for (let run = 1; run <= report.requiredConsecutivePasses; run++) {
    const ownedResource = join(scratchRoot, `owned-workbook-${run}.json`);
    const state = { value: scenario.seedValue, setting: 'original' };
    let failure = null;
    try {
      state.setting = 'changed';
      state.value += scenario.increment;
      writeFileSync(ownedResource, JSON.stringify(state));
      const observed = JSON.parse(readFileSync(ownedResource, 'utf8'));
      if (observed.value !== report.expectedValue) failure = 'workbook-value-mismatch';
    } finally {
      if (scenario.restoreSetting) state.setting = 'original';
      if (state.setting !== 'original') failure ??= 'setting-not-restored';
      rmSync(ownedResource);
    }
    assert.equal(existsSync(ownedResource), false);
    assert.equal(readFileSync(unownedResource, 'utf8'), 'preserve-this-session');
    report.runs.push({ run, status: failure ? 'failed' : 'passed' });
    if (failure) {
      report.failure = failure;
      report.consecutivePasses = 0;
      break;
    }
    report.consecutivePasses++;
  }
  report.ownedResourcesRemoved = report.runs.every(({ run }) =>
    !existsSync(join(scratchRoot, `owned-workbook-${run}.json`)));
  report.unownedResourcePreserved =
    readFileSync(unownedResource, 'utf8') === 'preserve-this-session';
} finally {
  rmSync(unownedResource);
  rmSync(scratchRoot, { recursive: true });
}
console.log(JSON.stringify(report));
if (report.consecutivePasses !== report.requiredConsecutivePasses) process.exitCode = 1;
